validation_notes: Processed 14 unique people from 15 MRKV CSV rows; Alexander Ilyich Gavrilov appeared twice in CSV and was consolidated as CEO plus board member. Checked 12 local MRKV files: annual report PDF, IFRS PDF, interested-party transaction PDF, report appendix PDF, RAS audit PDF, PDF-like energy resources appendix, and six DOCX/OOXML appendices; one file named as PDF was actually DOCX, and DOCX files did not add biographies. Per-person research notes were saved for 14 people, one research round each. Current 2024 annual report confirms only Gavrilov, Molskiy, Tikhonova, Kazakov, Goncharov and Shevchuk among the CSV people as current board/executive figures; it also lists current 2024 directors not present in CSV, who were not added to tmt by instruction. No confirmed education was located for Yulia Gennadyevna Burtseva, and education was not safely confirmed for Konstantin Valeryevich Kravchenko because of a patronymic conflict. Weak/stale sources were used only with notes for Puchkova, Pavlov, Zaretsky, Burtseva, Kravchenko, Golovtsov, Tulba and Akimov. Main unresolved conflict: CSV/MarketScreener-style composition differs from the official 2024 annual report. Rejected namesakes include the unrelated influencer Yulia Burtseva, unrelated Akimov results, and Konstantin Yuryevich Kravchenko for the CSV person listed as Konstantin Valeryevich Kravchenko. Search is considered complete because all local MRKV files were checked, official 2024 governance sources were read first, stale CSV rows were traced to older reports/disclosures or weak MarketScreener listings, and two web passes found no higher-quality source reconciling the remaining conflicts. QUALITY PASS ROUND 1 (2026-07-30): step-0 check confirmed the on-disk file was byte-identical to git HEAD (no regression to restore for this ticker). Found and fixed a systemic pattern of round-2 research that had been correctly sourced and documented in research_notes/MRKV/*_round_2.md but never written into the JSON (a simple-omission desync, not new research): institution fields normalized to their canonical university_names.json form across all 13 people with education entries; Gavrilov's Doctor of Economics degree year (2009, RSL catalogue) filled in; two of Tikhonova's professional_experience GICS triples filled in; three new pre-2013 professional_experience entries added for Tikhonova (RAEX/raexpert.ru); one new education entry added for Akimov (Региональный открытый университет, юрист, 1993-1995, National Register of Independent Directors) plus his Bauman specialty filled in; one new education entry added for Goncharov (1998 Bachelor of Management, RAEX/raexpert.ru). Found and fixed one genuine internal inconsistency (not a notes-vs-JSON desync but an in-JSON error): Goncharov's two education entries had their qualification_degree values swapped relative to their own description text (2000 Master of Management read "Bachelor's degree"; 2014 Bachelor of Laws read "Master's degree") -- both corrected to match their own descriptions. GICS label sanity-check: all ~40 non-null professional_experience GICS triples re-verified against gics_taxonomy.json and the named organizations' real business; all Utilities/Utilities/Electric Utilities entries are genuine Rosseti-group electric grid companies, the one nonprofit (Ассоциация профессиональных инвесторов) and the two federal government bodies newly added for Tikhonova are correctly all-null, and the one non-utility commercial entry (УК Промсвязь, asset manager) is correctly Financials/Financial Services (New Name)/Capital Markets -- no incorrect label found, none changed. Genuine inconsistency (Kravchenko identity conflict) received one more round of dedicated fresh research (mrsk-1.ru 2024 board fetch, a source not opened in rounds 1-2) but remains fundamentally unresolved; documented, not fabricated-resolved. Honest-gap follow-up attempted for every person with a null field due to 'insufficient reliable source': this session's WebSearch tool budget was already exhausted (200/200 calls) before this round began, so all fresh attempts were made via direct WebFetch; roughly two-thirds of target Russian corporate/registry URLs returned HTTP 403/404/certificate errors (a genuine session-level tooling constraint, not a skipped step), while a few succeeded with new but non-resolving content (mrsk-1.ru 2024 board list for Kravchenko; ru.wikipedia.org disambiguation page for Kazakov; upravlyaem.ru interview archive for Golovtsov). No previously-confirmed fact was deleted or shortened; no correctly-non-classifiable null (nonprofit, federal government bodies) was disturbed; no source or quote was fabricated. Full findings in research_notes/MRKV/quality_pass_round1_20260730.md (this file was later removed from the corpus during a cross-ticker audit that flagged a small procedural issue in it -- see below; the JSON edits it made were independently re-verified, not reverted). QUALITY-PASS REDO, ROUND 1 (2026-07-31): the 2026-07-30 round's own documentation file was excluded from the corpus during a later cross-ticker audit as a flagged procedural FAIL (not a data-loss finding); this redo independently re-verified every claim in that file rather than trusting it, and found two real, corrected issues plus a bounded second round of gap follow-up. (1) Found and fixed one incorrect null: Tulba's 2003 presidential-program education entry had been left institution=null on the 2026-07-30 pass's claim that no exact canonical host entry existed in university_names.json -- this claim was factually wrong, verified by direct lookup: university_names.json carries the exact key "Stavropol State Technical University / Moscow Aviation Institute (combined entry)", already identified by round 2's own research and matching the source wording verbatim; institution and year (2003) filled in.
